sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October. After a recent loss, Sandbach will be looking to return to winning ways; they have won seven of their ten matches so far this season. Alsager Town sit bottom of the division with just 4 points and arrive in poor form, having won only once in their last five games, making this a favorable fixture for the leaders.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town host struggling Dawley Town on Saturday, looking to bounce back after their own recent loss. AFC Bridgnorth face a challenging away trip to Eccleshall, who are in good recent form with a win in their last outing. Wolverhampton Casuals travel to Wednesfield Community in a midweek fixture on Wednesday before their Saturday encounter, while the same Wednesday sees Brereton Social host Wednesfield Community—Brereton's second fixture of the week after hosting Widnes Town on Saturday. In-form Bilston Town visit Foley Meir on Saturday, while Barnton host Shawbury United in a clash between mid-table sides. Market Drayton Town face New Mills on Saturday; New Mills are struggling mid-table while Market Drayton sit just above them. Crewe host Allscott Heath, and Cheadle Heath Nomads travel to Telford Town in a battle between two of the division's lowest-scoring teams. Widnes Town, pointless and winless this season, travel to Brereton Social on Saturday.
